purpose: Adjudicate PBE versus GW-level topology on identical polyacene structures before any phonon-limited transport reproduction claim.

candidate_order.reason: published cross-study PBE/GW labels both place N=7 on the topological side; this is not yet same-structure consensus
published PBE/GW labels disagree for N=5

pbe_reference_setup.note: Exact executable/version/pseudopotential files must be pinned before same-structure adjudication.

independent_checks: direct band data versus SSH-fit classification when SSH fit is used
mesh/cutoff/band-count convergence around the discrete topology boundary

decision_states.PROMOTE_N7_TO_QG0D_TRANSPORT_REPRODUCTIO: N=7 is topological under both converged PBE and GW-level calculations on the identical hashed structure; parity/Berry paths agree; classification is stable to frozen convergence and fit uncertainty.
decision_states.RETAIN_METHOD_DEPENDENCE: PBE and GW-level calculations disagree on the identical hashed structure or independent topological markers disagree.
decision_states.KILL_OR_PIVOT_POLYACENE_QG_BRANCH: N=7 becomes trivial at the converged higher-level method or classification cannot be stabilized without discretionary tuning.
decision_states.INCOMPLETE: structure hashes differ, method inputs are unresolved, convergence is inadequate, or required independent markers are missing.

forbidden_promotions: Cross-study label agreement is not same-structure method consensus.
Published diffusion enhancement is not a project physical result.
Arithmetic exactness of printed literature values is not physical precision.
No phonon-limited transport reproduction claim before this adjudication reaches PROMOTE_N7_TO_QG0D_TRANSPORT_REPRODUCTION.
